comprehension.opening_rationale: Beat B033 opens on an isolated push-in on Juliana mid-speech ('You wanted this entire chapel to believe...') without an establishing view of the opponent or the spatial dynamic between bride, groom, and altar, creating an ungrounded opening for a cold viewer.
comprehension.arc_rationale: The full clip clearly communicates that Juliana is being publicly rejected in front of a chapel assembly and turns the humiliation back onto the groom before resolving to leave without shame.
comprehension.situational_summary: In front of an assembled chapel, a bride repudiates a man's attempt to deem her unworthy and proudly walks away without shame.

emotional_salience.emotional_core: Fierce public defiance and unassailable moral victory over humiliation
